thesis: The podcast argues that despite massive corporate spending on AI, there is a critical lack of measurement infrastructure to determine if the technology actually delivers productivity benefits, drawing a parallel to the early days of digital advertising where companies needed tools like CommScore to prove ads worked before budgets grew. The speakers posit that the next wave of AI success will depend on building boring governance and measurement tools to validate AI's impact on workforce operations and security, rather than just selling more AI tools.
